# coralogix_user (Data Source)

Coralogix User. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/manage-team-members/.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coralogix_custom_role" "example" {
  name        = "Example custom role"
  description = "This role is created with terraform!"
  parent_role = "Standard User"
  permissions = ["spans.events2metrics:UpdateConfig"]
}

resource "coralogix_user" "example" {
  user_name = "example@coralogix.com"
  name = {
    given_name  = "example"
    family_name = "example"
  }
}

data "coralogix_user" "imported_by_id" {
  id = coralogix_user.example.id
}

data "coralogix_user" "imported_by_user_name" {
  user_name  = "example@coralogix.com"
  depends_on = [coralogix_user.example]
}

resource "coralogix_group" "members_by_email" {
  display_name = "example-members-by-email"
  role         = coralogix_custom_role.example.name
  members      = [data.coralogix_user.imported_by_user_name.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) User ID.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active. The provider manages the whole status of the user through this attribute: `false` deactivates the user, `true` activates them. It defaults to `true`.
- `allowed_login_mode` (List of String) List of allowed login modes. Can include SSO, local authentication, or both.
- `groups` (Set of String) The ids of the groups the user belongs to, as decimal strings, the values SCIM returned in groups[].value. A user with no memberships has a known empty set.
- `name` (Attributes) The name of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--name))
- `user_name` (String) User name (email). Comparison is case-insensitive: SSO login can normalize letter case in the backend, and that normalization will not trigger drift in subsequent plans.

<a id="nestedatt--name"></a>
### Nested Schema for `name`

Read-Only:

- `family_name` (String) The family (last) name of the user.
- `given_name` (String) The given (first) name of the user.
